entries.title: I Timothy 2:1
segments: I exhort therefore, first of all, that supplications, prayers, intercessions, thanksgivings, be made for all men;

entries.title: I Timothy 2:2
segments: for kings and all that are in high place; that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and gravity.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:3
segments: This is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;

entries.title: I Timothy 2:4
segments: who would have all men to be saved, and come to the knowledge of the truth.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:5
segments: For there is one God, one mediator also between God and men, [himself] man, Christ Jesus,

entries.title: I Timothy 2:6
segments: who gave himself a ransom for all; the testimony [to be borne] in its own times;

entries.title: I Timothy 2:7
segments: whereunto I was appointed a preacher and an apostle (I speak the truth, I lie not), a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:8
segments: I desire therefore that the men pray in every place, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and disputing.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:9
segments: In like manner, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefastness and sobriety; not with braided hair, and gold or pearls or costly raiment;

entries.title: I Timothy 2:10
segments: but (which becometh women professing godliness) through good works.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:11
segments: Let a woman learn in quietness with all subjection.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:12
segments: But I permit not a woman to teach, nor to have dominion over a man, but to be in quietness.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:13
segments: For Adam was first formed, then Eve;

entries.title: I Timothy 2:14
segments: and Adam was not beguiled, but the woman being beguiled hath fallen into transgression:

entries.title: I Timothy 2:15
segments: but she shall be saved through her child-bearing, if they continue in faith and love and sanctification with sobriety.
